rationale: The blocker is not capacity, data, or sites; it is the objective. Your own diagnostics show |cos| starts around 0.035 and remains negative, so cos_sq_plus_signed collapses to cos^2 with gradient proportional to |cos|, i.e. tiny exactly where learning must start. That explains the flat M4 and inactive downstream behavior. Switching to pure signed cosine changes the local gradient at cos≈0 from near-zero to O(1), directly pushing activations opposite the harmful direction without needing more alpha, more layers, or more data. Holding every other knob fixed makes the rerun a clean mechanism test: if Δcos_harmful moves substantially while control directions stay near zero and retention remains acceptable, the RR mechanism is finally engaged. This is the single highest-probability one-iteration fix for moving from −0.02 toward the target ≤−0.30 within the remaining budget.
expected_signal: Success if held-out M4 reaches Δcos_harmful <= -0.30, with Δcos_ctrl near 0 (e.g. |Δ| < 0.05) and no late retention collapse.
